# AxisWorks

> AxisWorks es un estudio de dos personas que diseña y programa webs y herramientas a
> medida, y ayuda a sus clientes a captar clientes. Trabajamos en español e inglés, desde
> España y Bali.

## Contacto
- Email: hello@axisworks.studio
- Web: https://axisworks.studio

## Key facts
- What we do: custom tool suites, web design and development, social/SEO/SEM, Meta sales
  funnels, and brand and management advisory
- Approach: hand-coded, non-template, design and development in the same hands
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Based: Spain ✕ Bali

## Services
- **Custom tool suites** — internal tools built around how the business actually runs
- **Web design and development** — hand-coded sites and the infrastructure behind them
- **Social media, SEO and SEM** — organic reach and paid search
- **Meta sales funnels** — campaigns and creative built to bring in enquiries
- **Advisory** — management, brand and direction: where the company is going, how the
  brand carries it there, and what to build first

## Pricing
No published rates. Every project is quoted on its own scope. Contact
hello@axisworks.studio and we come back with scope and a price.
